description: Draws a spread of 1–78 random cards from the Pipeworx original tarot deck (Rider–Waite–Smith tradition), each with its own orientation and traditional meaning for that orientation.

reversals.description: Allow reversed orientation (50% chance per card). Default true; pass false to always draw upright.

seed.description: Reproduce a previous draw by passing back the seed it returned. Omit for fresh randomness.

session_id.description: Draw from an open tarot_shuffle session instead of a fresh single-call draw (hosted only; never repeats a card within the session).

name: draw_cards

name.description: Full name of the tarot card

suit.description: Suit of the card (null for Major Arcana)

title: Draw Cards
